_comment: Opening-masterclass content manifests (David 2026-05-22). Each first-class opening declares its MINIMUM curated content counts; the openingManifests test gates against them. If a manifest entry exceeds the current count, the build fails — preventing accidental regressions (deleted variations, dropped plans, lost weapons) and forcing intentional demotions to be explicit. Floors should track the CURRENT state and ratchet UP as content lands; never down without explicit demotion in this file.

_schema.middlegamePlans: min plans in middlegame-plans.json with openingId match, id NOT ending -endgame
_schema.endgamePlans: min plans in middlegame-plans.json with openingId match, id ending -endgame
_schema.modelGames: min entries in model-games.json with openingId match
_schema.weapons: min `kind: 'weapon'` entries in <opening>TrapLessons.ts (0 if no trap file)
